written.headline: Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona
written.summary: State lawmakers and officials are pushing back against new AI data center projects in Arizona, citing the state's long‑term water depletion and recent drought, even as earlier TSMC chip fabs were approved.

written.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
written.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture (DEPA) for AI training, outlining a techno‑legal framework for secure data collaboration. The framework lets institutions share data while retaining control, using contractual permissions, clean rooms and privacy safeguards.
